variant_source_qa.variant_reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName:'Rel-19'}) RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber:'RAN3#130'}) WHERE t.status='agreed' RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber

MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName:'Samsung'}), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(w:WorkItem {workItemCode:'NR_newRAT-Core'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meetingNumber,t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber

MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.413'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(p:Section {sectionNumber:'9.3.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH p,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC,rk.id ASC,p.sectionId ASC LIMIT 1 MATCH (p)-[:HAS_SUB_SECTION]->(c:Section) RETURN DISTINCT c.sectionId AS sectionId,c.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,c.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle

MATCH (cr:CR)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName:'Rel-18'}), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber AS specNumber,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt ORDER BY crCnt DESC,specNumber ASC LIMIT 5
MATCH (f:TSFigure)-[:FIGURE_IN_SECTION]->(s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber AS specNumber,count(DISTINCT f) AS figCnt

MATCH (sec:Section {sectionNumber:'9.4.5'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber:'38.473'}) MATCH (sec)<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(c:CR) RETURN DISTINCT c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,c.reasonForChange AS reason

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName:'Rel-17'}), (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber,s.specNumber AS specNumber,imp.impactType AS impactType

property_probes.name: Meeting130
property_probes.query: MATCH (m:Meeting {meetingNumberInt:130}) RETURN m.meetingNumber AS meetingNumber,m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS canonicalMeetingNumber,m.wg AS wg,keys(m) AS propertyKeys LIMIT 3

property_probes.name: Spec38.413
property_probes.query: MATCH (s:Spec {specNumber:'38.413'}) RETURN s.id AS id,s.specRelease AS specRelease,s.version AS version,keys(s) AS propertyKeys ORDER BY s.specRelease LIMIT 8

property_probes.name: CRreason
property_probes.query: MATCH (c:CR) WHERE c.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,keys(c) AS propertyKeys LIMIT 1
